errors.evidence: The description uses the word 'дружените' (friendly/allied), which is incorrect. The original caption and reference use 'полезните' (useful), referring to 'useful living areas'.

errors.text_span: Етикетите на оста X са разположени на всеки две години
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the x-axis labels are placed every two years. The chart image clearly shows labels for every single year from 2005 to 2021.

The description systematically omits the unit 'thousand' (хил.) when reporting values. The y-axis is labeled 'хил. кв. м.' (thousand sq. m.), but the description reports values like '800 кв.м.' instead of '800 thousand sq. m.', understating the values by a factor of 1000. This error is repeated for all data points.

errors.text_span: се повишава до приблизително 1400 кв.м. през 2008 г.
errors.evidence: The chart's peak value of approximately 1400 thousand sq. m. occurs in the year 2009, not 2008 as stated in the description. The value in 2008 is lower, at around 1380.

errors.text_span: продължава да намалява до приблизително 750 кв.м. през 2014 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the value in 2014 was approximately 750. The value in 2014 is actually around 820. The value of 750 corresponds to the year 2013.

errors.text_span: През 2020 г. линията се повишава до приблизително 1150 кв.м. и остава така през 2021 г.
errors.evidence: This statement contains two errors. First, the value in 2020 is approximately 1020, not 1150; 1150 is closer to the value for 2021. Second, the value does not 'remain so' in 2021 but continues to increase from ~1020 in 2020 to ~1160 in 2021.
The description fails to mention that the line has circular markers at each annual data point.
